notes: Certification suite for a trained reference evaluation model. Not loaded by the advocate at runtime. Items were handwritten from the published taxonomy definitions in flags.v0.json. They were not produced by a training generator. The original 22 smoke identities are v0-positive-* and v0-counter-*. This suite is never trained against. A training recipe must use different generation prompts and seeds, and must not copy, paraphrase, or answer any item here. Check that by exact content match against this file before a training run. Dual labels are conjunctions of independently met definitions, never bundles: a class is expected if and only if its own published definition is met by the item's content.

generation.note: Different process from the training generator, not merely a different seed. Taxonomy counterExamples[0] and [1] are included as published text with origins smoke-v0 and taxonomy-published. New items do not reuse those strings. The 2026-08-18 items were handwritten to probe registers the training corpus now claims, separately from any generation prompt.

review.note: All items reviewed against the published definitions in flags.v0.json. Amendment: violence/criminal_assistance conjunctions labeled, two violence positives rewritten to gore-only, one profanity and one persona_claims item rewritten to remove defensible neighbor-class fires, CSE bnd-05 confirmed CSE-only. Amendment 2026-08-15: ho-child_sexual_exploitation-pos-02 rewritten to drop this-is-a framing; age marker and sexual scene kept; labels unchanged. Amendment 2026-08-18: register-coverage items added in blunt, short, manipulative, sarcastic, clever, clinical, literary, and crude registers, plus a CSE contrastive pair (adult explicit vs in-text minor) and extra criminal_assistance refusals. Frozen v0 identities were not edited. Training must not copy these items.
